BreakEvenAnalysis.Context: Back-of-napkin break-even check on Crossroads Conservatory ahead of the October 2026 Grand Blvd lease renewal. Pre-CPA draft before sending figures to Gloria Martin.

CurrentState.Note: Tuition from the 85-student base is the swing factor; drop-ins and performance fees are seasonal and not dependable. Annual gross runs roughly $165k, growing about 12% year over year.

Scenario_A_RentTo750.Label: Rent rises to $2,950 at lease renewal
Scenario_A_RentTo750.BreakEvenCalculation: Fixed costs $6,215 + $150 increase = $6,365. At ~$140 effective rate per student, $6,365 / $140 = 45.5, so 46 students minimum.
Scenario_A_RentTo750.Impact: Absorbable; still covers the $6,000 owner draw with reserve to spare.

Scenario_B_RentTo850.Label: Lose a rotating guest instructor
Scenario_B_RentTo850.Impact: Improves margin short term but caps class capacity and risks burnout; not sustainable past one season.

BreakEvenAnalysis.KeyInsight: Even with a rent bump the conservatory stays comfortably profitable as long as active enrollment holds above roughly 46 students paying the average tuition rate.
ActionItems: Confirm the exact renewal figure with Grand Arts Properties before the October 2026 lease review
Run a fall enrollment drive to build a buffer above the 46-student break-even line
